message: Vector Rebel 3.2.90: pause/resume/stop Daily Captain history check, keep completed-but-failed inspections distinct, simplify errors.
releaseNotes: Daily Captain read-only history audit now shows prominent Pause/Resume and Stop controls on the bottom-right live progress panel. Pause takes effect at the next safe item boundary and preserves reads; Resume continues from the next item after reload. Stop asks for confirmation, aborts without submitting an inspection or marking the interrupted audit completed, and preserves the previous completed report. Native completion dates and PASS/FAIL verdicts are separate: any completed date counts as COMPLETED even when an explicitly recorded native failed result exists; only unambiguous native Passed/Failed result cells establish PASS/FAIL. If the Item Log shows only completion without answers, display completed, result UNKNOWN, never falsely green PASS or yellow pending. The current report shows finished count and explicit failed items, and the two-month grid uses green PASS, red completed FAILED, blue completed verdict UNKNOWN, yellow pending and gray OFF. Errors & Alerts is reduced to a simple Software Issues overview grouped into plain-language categories, with hidden technical details and optional Clear New Badge acknowledgment that retains all server reports. No official PPE inspections submitted, no CrewSense writes, no emails. Background worker controls are separate from Captain flow. Full per-question historical failed-answer extraction requires native inspection detail confirmation where Item Log does not explicitly expose outcome.
